items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee mentions studying dancing but does not mention any direct interaction, collaboration, or personal relationship with Johnny Hines, who is only mentioned by the interviewer as having a dance school.

ctx.x: Philly had so much diversity, between dancing schools, Judamarn (?), Johnny Hines, you know just a variety of cultures. The Academy of Music was a place you go on Saturday to see different things.
So a very, very rich cultural center.
